# International Journal of Engineering and Computer Science (IJECS)

> > IJECS is a peer-reviewed, open-access journal publishing cutting-edge research in engineering and computer science with rigorous editorial standards and global reach.

IJECS is an international academic journal based in Mandsaur, Madhya Pradesh, India, dedicated to disseminating high-quality research across engineering and computer science domains. The journal maintains COPE-aligned publication ethics, employs double-blind peer review, and operates under Creative Commons licensing to maximize research accessibility and impact.

## Journal Overview

- [International Journal of Engineering and Computer Science](https://ijecs.in/index.php/ijecs): IJECS homepage: peer-reviewed open-access journal for engineering and CS research
- [IJECS Homepage](https://ijecs.in): Main homepage for peer-reviewed open-access engineering and CS journal
- [About IJECS](https://ijecs.in/index.php/ijecs/about): About page detailing IJECS mission, scope, and publication standards
- [Editorial Board](https://ijecs.in/index.php/ijecs/editorial): Editorial board members including Dr. Ashok Koujalagi and international scholars

## Author Resources & Guidelines

- [Author Guidelines](https://ijecs.in/index.php/ijecs/authorguide): Manuscript submission, formatting, and citation requirements for authors
- [Peer Review Process](https://ijecs.in/index.php/ijecs/reviewprocess): Double-blind peer review workflow and manuscript evaluation procedures
- [Publication Ethics](https://ijecs.in/index.php/ijecs/ethics): COPE-aligned research integrity and editorial standards for IJECS
- [Anti-Plagiarism Policy](https://ijecs.in/index.php/ijecs/pp): Plagiarism detection and academic integrity standards for submissions

## Publication & Access Policies

- [Open Access Policy](https://ijecs.in/index.php/ijecs/oa): CC-BY 4.0 open access publishing policy and copyright licensing
- [Rights and License](https://ijecs.in/index.php/ijecs/RightandLicense): CC BY 4.0 Creative Commons licensing and author rights information
- [Publication Fees](https://ijecs.in/index.php/ijecs/fee): Article processing charges in USD and INR for open-access publishing
- [Payment Methods](https://ijecs.in/index.php/ijecs/mod): Payment modes including PayPal for publication fee submission
